which-app.q: Which app do I need for my climbing board?
which-app.a: Each brand has its own app: Kilter, Tension, MoonBoard, Decoy, Touchstone, Grasshopper, So iLL and Woods. Boardsesh lights all eight from one app and covers your spray wall too.

one-logbook.q: Can one app log Kilter, Tension and MoonBoard together?
one-logbook.a: Yes. Every board shares one logbook, with Kilter, Tension, Aurora file and MoonBoard CSV imports, and at a gym you switch walls in the same session, even within one queue.

offline.a: Yes, in the iPhone, iPad and Android apps: download a board, then search, climb and log offline, and ticks sync when you're back. The browser app needs a connection.

android.q: Does it work on Android phones without Google?
android.a: Boardsesh runs on Android 7.0 or newer and doesn't check for Google certification. MoonBoard's Android app needs a Google-certified phone, and Moon support told a GrapheneOS user in January 2026 there is no plan to change that.

tablet.q: Does it work on an iPad or tablet?
tablet.a: Yes, iPad gets a sidebar, a mini player and a landscape player, and Android tablets get a sidebar rail. Kilter's and MoonBoard's iPad apps show the phone layout scaled up, and Tension's iPhone app runs scaled up on iPad.

free.a: Yes. Every feature is free for everyone, with no ads, Boardsesh doesn't sell your data, and the code is open source under Apache-2.0.

method.heading: How we compared
method.body: We make Boardsesh and say so on every page. Facts about other apps come from their own store listings, release notes and support pages, read on 2026-11-24, with a source link beside each claim. We did not test every official app on its own board, and a feature marked not documented may exist. If we got something wrong, tell us and we will fix it.

faq.heading: What climbers ask before their first session

free.q: Is the Kilter Board app free?
free.a: Yes. Kilter's app is free with no in-app purchases or ads listed, and Boardsesh is free for every feature, with no ads and open source code.

both.q: Can I use Boardsesh and the Kilter app on the same board?
both.a: Yes, both light the same board over Bluetooth. A Kilter board talks to one phone at a time, so disconnect one app before you connect the other.

not-working.q: Why is the Kilter app not working for me?
not-working.a: Kilter's support page says to update the app and restart it, and to register a new account, because old logins don't carry over. If it still fails, report it at kilterboard.io/feedback and light the board with Boardsesh in the meantime.

homewall.q: Does Boardsesh work with the Kilter Homewall?
homewall.a: Yes. Boardsesh covers Kilter Board Original and Homewall on iPhone, iPad, Android and in a Chrome or Edge browser.

tablet.q: Does it work on an iPad or tablet?
tablet.a: Yes, on iPad you get a sidebar, a mini player and a landscape player, and Android tablets get a sidebar rail. Kilter's iPad app shows its phone layout scaled up in its App Store screenshots.

old-logbook.q: How do I get my old Kilter logbook into a new app?
old-logbook.a: Email support@auroraclimbing.com for your JSON export and load it in Boardsesh, where the import starts right away; in March 2026 Climbing magazine pointed climbers to Boardsesh for old Kilter logs on every board size. Kilter's claim page takes the same file and quotes 5 to 7 business days.

brands.heading: Five Aurora brands in Boardsesh
brands.lead: Each brand keeps its own layouts, sizes and app. Here is what Boardsesh covers for each one and what the brand's own app offers. Counts are from our October 2026 catalogue study; ratings were read on 24 November 2026.

tension.name: Tension Board
tension.summary: TB1 and both TB2 layouts. Sign in with your Tension account and your sends come into Boardsesh, with new ones following.
tension.layouts: Original Layout (TB1), Tension Board 2 Mirror, Tension Board 2 Spray
tension.sizes: 10 in all. TB1: Full Wall, Half Kickboard, No Kickboard, Short, Short & Narrow. TB2 (high x wide): 12x12, 10x12, 12x8, 10x8, 12x16. Sets A, B, C and Foot on TB1; Wood and Plastic on TB2, plus expansion sets on the 12x16
tension.angles: 0 to 70 degrees in 5 degree steps; mirror lighting on TB1 and TB2 Mirror
tension.benchmarks: At 40°: 517 on TB1, 286 on TB2 Mirror, 184 on TB2 Spray
tension.officialApp: Tension Board 2 on iOS, Tension Board on Google Play: 3.51 from 65 ratings (US App Store) and 3.30 from 80 (Google Play). Workout AI, which plans a session from your workout type and logbook history, since August 2025, leaderboards since February 2026. Listed LED colours: green start, blue middle, red finish, magenta feet.

decoy.name: Decoy Board
decoy.summary: The Dungeon Trainer in three sizes. Decoy's app renamed benchmarks to Selects and has a side-climb filter that Boardsesh doesn't match.
decoy.sizes: 8x10, 8x12 and 12x12; 19 hold sets on the 12x12, from Foundation and Pacos to Limestone, and 12 on the smaller walls
decoy.angles: 0 to 70 degrees in 5 degree steps; mirror lighting supported
decoy.benchmarks: 166 at 40°; the Decoy app calls its list Selects
decoy.officialApp: Decoy Board: 5.0 from 6 ratings (US App Store) and 4.8 from 5 (Google Play). Selects, its name for benchmarks, since June 2023; leaderboards and badges since July 2023; an Only Side Climbs filter since September 2023.

grasshopper.name: Grasshopper Board
grasshopper.summary: Adjustable walls that tilt past vertical into slab. Boardsesh offers the -5° setting and splits each climb's history by angle.
grasshopper.sizes: Ninja (8x10), Master (8x12) and GrandMaster (12x12), each with or without Tweeners; sets Engage, Flow, Power, Gradient, Dimension and Tweeners
grasshopper.benchmarks: 9 at 30°; the official app is the better place for Grasshopper benchmarks
grasshopper.officialApp: Grasshopper Board: 4.05 from 21 ratings (US App Store) and 4.13 from 25 (Google Play), 10K+ installs. Benchmarks, leaderboards and badges since July 2023, Only Side Climbs since September 2023.

touchstone.name: Touchstone Board
touchstone.summary: One layout in one size, so there's little to set up. Boardsesh listed 1,087 Touchstone climbs at 35°, the busiest angle.
touchstone.sizes: Full Size, with one hold set (All Holds)
touchstone.officialApp: Touchstone Board: 3.33 from 3 ratings (US App Store), none shown on Google Play, 1K+ installs. iOS version 3.9.14, released 10 February 2026.

so-ill.name: So iLL Board
so-ill.summary: Two widths of the Summer 2024 layout. Boardsesh lets you pick your own LED colour for start, hand, finish and foot holds.
so-ill.sizes: 8x12 (11 hold columns) and 12x12 (17 hold columns), both 20 rows, one hold set
so-ill.benchmarks: None in Boardsesh's catalogue; 540 climbs listed at 30°
so-ill.officialApp: So iLL Board: no ratings on the US App Store or Google Play, 1K+ installs. iOS version 3.9.14, released 10 February 2026. Listed LED colours: green start, magenta middle, cyan finish, white feet.

faq.heading: What climbers ask before their first Aurora session

free.q: Is the Tension Board app free?
free.a: Yes. Tension's app is free with no ads or purchases, like the other Aurora apps, and Boardsesh is free with every feature open to everyone.

one-app.q: Can one app run my Tension and Kilter boards?
one-app.a: Not with the official apps: Aurora ships one app per brand, and Kilter's new app covers Kilter alone. Boardsesh runs both and keeps the ticks in one logbook.

decoy.a: Yes, on the 8x10, 8x12 and 12x12, with Decoy's hold sets and angles from 0 to 70 degrees. It lights older and newer Aurora controllers.

so-ill.q: Is there a So iLL board app?
so-ill.a: Yes. Aurora Climbing publishes the free So iLL Board app for iPhone and Android, and Boardsesh also works with So iLL's Summer 2024 boards.

grasshopper.q: Does Boardsesh support the Grasshopper -5 degree setting?
grasshopper.a: Yes. Grasshopper angles in Boardsesh run from -5 to 70 degrees, and each climb's history is split by the angle you climbed it at.

import.q: Can I bring my Aurora logbook into Boardsesh?
import.a: Yes. Sign in with your account on any of the five brands' cards under Connected apps and the logbook copies one way into Boardsesh; an Aurora JSON file is the fallback for an account you can't sign in to.

not-working.q: Why is the Tension Board app not working?
not-working.a: Update the app, sign out and back in, then forget and re-pair the board in your phone's Bluetooth settings. If it still won't load, Boardsesh can light the same Tension board while you wait for a fix.

method.heading: How we compared
method.body: We read the App Store and Google Play listings and version histories of all five Aurora apps, plus Tension's FAQ, on 24 November 2026. Boardsesh rows were checked against its own code and docs, and catalogue counts come from our October 2026 workout study. We didn't test any app on a physical board for this page. Boardsesh is not affiliated with Aurora Climbing or any of the five brands; if a row is wrong, tell us and we'll fix it.

not-working.q: Why is the MoonBoard app not working or stuck on Please Wait?

leds.q: Will Boardsesh light my MoonBoard LEDs?

favourites.q: Do I lose my MoonBoard favourites if I reinstall the app?

csv.q: Can I import my MoonBoard logbook into Boardsesh?
csv.a: Yes. Ask Moon for your CSV (Boardsesh's MoonBoard card copies the request for you), then import it; it copies one way, for climbs logged at 25 and 40 degrees.

hero.lead: Boardsesh puts your home-wall sends beside your gym-board sends, from Kilter, Tension, MoonBoard, Woods and the Aurora boards, in one logbook. Boardsesh and Crux both keep home walls free, and Stōkt sells hold mapping per wall but also offers a free self-scan. verdict.heading: Which spray wall app fits your wall

verdict.bottomLine: For a wall of your own, Boardsesh and Crux cost nothing, and Stōkt maps every hold for a fee or offers a free self-scan. To try Boardsesh, photograph your wall, fix the holds and set a first problem; your sends go into the same logbook as your gym boards.

retro.a: Retro Flash is a free download, but home walls and gyms have needed a yearly pass since version 2.1.7 in July 2026. The US App Store lists the Home Wall Year Pass at $4.99.

leds.q: Can I light my spray wall with LEDs?
leds.a: Yes, through WLED, a low-cost open-source LED controller you wire yourself and connect over Wi-Fi. Stōkt sells its own LED kit in the EU and UK.

offline.q: Does a spray wall app work without signal?
offline.a: Boardsesh keeps your walls, climbs and logbook on the phone and syncs sends when you're back online. Stōkt, Crux and Retro Flash don't document offline use.

method.heading: How we compared
method.body: Competitor facts come from each app's store listing, website and public reviews, checked on 24 November 2026. We didn't test Stōkt, Retro Flash or Crux on a wall, and a feature missing from a listing is described as not documented, not as absent. Boardsesh rows were checked against its own code and docs. Spotted a mistake? Tell us and we'll fix it.

cta.heading: Put your wall in Boardsesh
cta.body: Free on iPhone, iPad, Android and in your browser. Open source, with no ads.
